title: Postcards and Undertow
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Delacroix, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
